pr.body: ## Summary Results-only upload. This branch is based on current `main` and adds only the front-review-r4 results directory. Models, weights, notebooks, and every other path are unchanged. The directory follows the same `results/gpu/--001/` layout as `results/gpu/baomai-sequence-fronts-l4-001`, and also keeps the stored transfer chunks and their checksums. - Source revision: `c8d8f30a5770c3cee25d0bd431df4f565ca5471f` - Notebook: `baomai_front_review_r4.ipynb` at `dba4d685fa7a62dbda1ec32e5f40a44b42bd6054` - Runtime: Colab NVIDIA L4 - Roles: reference and candidate - Both roles are complete at 30/30 epochs - Archive: `baomai-front-review-r4-seed46-v3-results.zip`, 39778742 bytes, SHA-256 `a60215759e9f800db687a11346c5edb08d363cca8dad61232a9553ec610f641b` The ZIP was reassembled by concatenating raw `part00` then `part01` after unzipping the stored chunk zips. `sha256sum -c` passed for the archive, the chunk zips, and the raw parts. `unzip -t` and `ZipFile.testzip()` reported no errors. The committed ZIP and chunk blobs are the raw bytes, not Git LFS pointers. ## Files - `results/gpu/baomai-front-review-r4-l4-001/baomai-front-review-r4-seed46-v3-results.zip` - `results/gpu/baomai-front-review-r4-l4-001/baomai-front-review-r4-seed46-v3-results.zip.sha256` - `results/gpu/baomai-front-review-r4-l4-001/baomai-front-review-r4-seed46-v3-results.zip.part00.zip` - `results/gpu/baomai-front-review-r4-l4-001/baomai-front-review-r4-seed46-v3-results.zip.part01.zip` - `results/gpu/baomai-front-review-r4-l4-001/chunks.sha256` - `results/gpu/baomai-front-review-r4-l4-001/parts.sha256` - `results/gpu/baomai-front-review-r4-l4-001/README.md` This records the returned archive. It makes no accuracy or performance claim.
